claim: In the matching retail DLL, FormAnimator.StartSlotAnm_Immediately (0x06004E71) has parameters SkillSlotEnum skill_slot, Int32 anm_bank, Boolean rev, and Int32 def_pl_idx. Its 38-byte body calls ReqSlotAnm(skill_slot, rev, def_pl_idx, true), stores this.plObj.GetSkillData_Equip(skill_slot, 0) into CurrentSkill, then calls StartAnm(anm_bank). In verified R6 raw capture bytes, all 36 observed PRE calls pair with POST calls and contain the direct child sequence ReqSlotAnm then StartAnm. In all 36, the child ReqSlotAnm arguments equal parent args 1, 3, and 4 plus literal true; the child StartAnm argument equals parent arg2; parent arg4 equals both the parent recorded target and child ReqSlotAnm recorded target; and the ReqSlotAnm POST resolved-skill record carries unchanged into the StartAnm PRE record and StartSlotAnm_Immediately POST record.
